nodes.description: Constructor of FlokiNoke that deploys the ERC20 with name/symbol and mints the entire supply to the deployer.
Internal ERC20 mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal ERC20 transfer that debits sender and credits recipient balances.
Internal ERC20 approval that writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
Public ERC20 transfer entrypoint that forwards to _transfer with _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transferFrom entrypoint that moves tokens and reduces allowance.
Public ERC20 approve entrypoint that forwards to _approve.
Public helper that atomically increases a spender allowance.
Public helper that atomically decreases a spender allowance.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0), permanently removing owner privileges.
onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner to a new account.
View function returning the current _owner.
Payable receive hook that accepts plain ETH transfers.
Context helper that returns the raw msg.sender caller.
Private ERC20 mapping of account balances.
Private nested mapping of owner-spender allowances.
Private total token supply.
Private Ownable owner address controlling privileged functions.
Private token name string.
Private token symbol string.
Caller-controlled address, the primary untrusted input of the contracts.
The one-shot _mint(msg.sender, totalSupply) call that creates the entire supply and grants it to the deployer.
Local variable holding 1 * 1e9 * 1e18 used as the minted amount.
Destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Allowance increment parameter of increaseAllowance.
Allowance decrement parameter of decreaseAllowance.
Token name constructor parameter passed as "FlokiNoke".
Token symbol constructor parameter passed as "NOKEY".
Guard modifier that reverts unless _owner equals _msgSender().
Base ERC20 constructor that writes the immutable-like _name and _symbol state variables.

edges.reason: FlokiNoke constructor invokes the base ERC20 constructor with the token name and symbol.
Constructor executes the one-time mint operation for the full supply.
Constructor calls the internal _mint function.
ERC20 constructor assigns the name argument into the _name state variable.
ERC20 constructor assigns the symbol argument into the _symbol state variable.
Name constructor parameter flows into the ERC20 constructor.
Symbol constructor parameter flows into the ERC20 constructor.
Local totalSupply value is used as the amount for the mint operation.
msg.sender is the recipient account of the one-time mint operation.
msg.sender is returned by the _msgSender helper.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the token source address.
_msgSender result is used as the sender for internal transfers.
_msgSender result is used as the allowance owner in _approve.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance computes and writes allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance computes and writes allowance through _approve.
_transfer reads and writes sender/recipient entries in _balances.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer as the destination.
amount parameter flows into _transfer as the transferred quantity.
sender parameter flows into _transfer as the source address.
spender parameter flows into _approve as the allowance target.
addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the current allowance in decreaseAllowance.
newOwner parameter is written into _owner by transferOwnership.
transferOwnership reads the current owner for the guarded ownership handover.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership reads _owner before clearing it.
renounceOwnership writes _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner compares the stored _owner against the caller.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against _owner.
onlyOwner gates execution of renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership.
owner() view returns the _owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The local totalSupply amount is only used as the argument of the one-time mint operation.
The recipient parameter exists only to supply the destination of _transfer.
The amount parameter exists only to supply the quantity moved by _transfer.
The sender parameter exists only to supply the source of _transfer in transferFrom.
The spender parameter exists only to supply the allowance target of _approve.
The newOwner parameter exists only to be written into _owner by transferOwnership.
The addedValue parameter exists only as the increment used by increaseAllowance.
The subtractedValue parameter exists only as the decrement used by decreaseAllowance.
The name_ parameter exists only to initialize _name via the ERC20 constructor.
The symbol_ parameter exists only to initialize _symbol via the ERC20 constructor.
